title: Evidence Ledger
description: Immutable record of source observations captured at read time and transcluded by later workflow phases.

capturedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the capture run.

commit.description: Commit SHA the observations were made against. Required when type is git.

root.description: Workspace-relative root the paths resolve against. Defaults to the workspace folder.

kind.description: present: quoted from a workspace file. absent: a verified null result. external: an artifact owned outside this workspace. remote: fetched from a URL.

path.description: Workspace-relative path. Required for present and absent.

startLine.description: Required for present. Forbidden for all other kinds.

endLine.description: Required for present. Must equal startLine + snippet line count - 1.

lang.description: Fence language identifier for the snippet.

snippet.description: Exact bytes of the cited range, newline separated. Required for present.

search.description: Required for absent. Records the query that returned nothing.

owner.description: Required for external. Owning repository, team, or platform function.

redactions.description: Zero-based line offsets within the snippet whose values were replaced at capture time.

note.description: Factual context only. Never a substitute for the snippet.
